periods.analysis: The number of new local businesses in Metropolis has been increasing at a steady rate. We could do more to promote these businesses and incorporate them into our processes via contracts.
periods.recommendations: Over the next few months we could consider partnering with businesses on some sort of "buy local" initiative, offering either memberships, discounts, or rewards to Metropolis citizens for supporting these businesses.
